- Last third mean: 0.4164 (getting closer to tipping)
- Last window: 0.156 (very close to tipping!)
- p_critical mean: 0.1026
- p_critical max: 0.6228
- p_critical last window: 0.6189 (high probability of being near tipping at the end)

- Share of windows above half: 0.0502 (only 5% of windows have p_critical > 0.5)
- Interval 90 width: mean 0.7133, last window 1.1551 (very wide uncertainty at the end)

However, the uncertainty is very high at the end (interval width 1.1551 at last window). And only 5% of windows have p_critical above 0.5.
